findings.detail: buildSha256 differs from dry run 4 (30e61363 vs 012b7efc) with identical source tree. Prisma generated clients copied into dist (backend/dist/src/generated/phase2-core, services/clinic/dist/generated/client, services/notification/dist/generated/client: index.js/edge.js/wasm.js) embed absolute generator.output and sourceFilePath; on Kaggle these contain /tmp/clinic-activity-d5-<run>/source, so every run yields a different build digest and therefore a different profileKey.
findings.required: Before timing, the D6 harness must record a path-normalized build digest (replace the run root in raw and JSON-escaped forms) next to the raw digest and use the normalized one in profileKey. Not changed in D5 source.

findings.detail: poolLimits list coreApi/clinicApi/clinicAudit/readWorker/notificationApi only. All processes use runtime databaseUrl() with DB_POOL_LIMIT=4 (PHASE2_RUNTIME_REQUIRED=1), audit 1, read worker CLINIC_READ_PROJECTOR_POOL_LIMIT=1. Clinic role is shared by API (4) + audit (1) + clinic-worker/relay (4): observed peak 6 <= 9; Core role shared by API + core-outbox + billing-worker: peak 4 <= 12. Within limits, but per-process ceilings must be in the frozen profile.
findings.required: D6 profile records per-process pool ceilings (core-api 4, core-outbox 4, billing-worker 4, clinic-api 4, clinic-audit 1, clinic-worker 4, read-worker 1, notification-api 4, notification-worker 4) and peaks per role.

findings.topic: profileKey trace/harness digests are D5-smoke specific
findings.detail: traceDigest/harnessDigest describe the D5 readiness smoke, not a D6 workload; a D6 session will carry its own digests. The reusable frozen part is the environment class, software versions, replicas, pool ceilings, fixture and policy.
